label: Preferred brain volume
note: STRUCTURE KEY: Stephan code 5 net brain = codes 6-10; do not key to a generic whole-brain volume. Model use remains the PGLS x-axis.

label: Corpus geniculatum laterale
note: STRUCTURE KEY: de Sousa 2010 Supp. Table 2 publishes a bilateral estimate = 2 x left entire LGN; the unsuffixed Evo term is correct. VERIFIED 2026-08-19: 44/49 agree. Five disagreements are specimen-set/version differences, not laterality.

label: Insular cortex (grey)
note: Stephan is LEFT only; Insula_Vol.mm3 is bilateral (~2x)

label: Area striata grey
note: STRUCTURE KEY: grey matter only and bilateral estimate as published in de Sousa 2010 Supp. Table 2 (= 2 x mean left V1). Do not key to Stephan 1981 Area_striata, which includes underlying white matter.

label: Cerebellum
note: merge can take MacLeod 2003 over Stephan on recency

label: Brain weight
note: merge Bauernfeind rows are in g under an .mg term -- upstream bug

label: Pons
note: SOURCE-CONDITIONED KEY: Matano 1985b rows are ventral pons (VPo); only the Zilles & Rehkamper Pongo row uses the broader Pons_Vol.mm3 term. The build script enforces the source constraint.

label: Neocortex (grey+white)
note: Stephan code 18: grey + underlying white matter + corpus callosum; includes insular/subgenual/cingular/retrosplenial transitional cortex.
